_about: Road distances to Trimbakeshwar, behind the distance hub and the two transport pages. status uses the same vocabulary as facts.json: verified needs verifiedBy + verifiedAt + a source an editor read; reported = published by the named sources but not yet measured by an editor; disputed = the sources disagree (every figure is shown); not_verified = no supporting source yet. Every row ships 'reported', 'disputed' or 'not_verified' because the official pages could not be opened from the build environment on 2026-11-22 (search-result snippets only). To verify a row: measure the shortest common road route on a maps service, set status verified, verifiedBy, verifiedAt, source and measuredOn.
method: Compiled on 22 Nov 2026 from the published sources named in each row. Not yet measured on a map by our editor, so no figure here is marked Verified.
